name: Narumi Isako
source:
First year student at the Law Department of Chihaya University, the same university [url=/c7874]Shougo[/url] attends. Isako has a sober and cool personailty. She is pretty but possesses a cold attitude and an unapproachable aura. But what is really on her heart?
